# Homelab Documentation

> GitOps-driven Kubernetes homelab on bare metal, running Flatcar Container Linux, Kubeadm, Cilium, Rook-Ceph and ArgoCD.

Bare-metal Kubernetes on Flatcar Container Linux. Ansible and a PXE boot
server bring the nodes up; Argo CD owns everything after that. The pages are
reference material: architecture decisions, one page per platform component,
operations runbooks and the contribution workflow.
